title: Continuity of bounded-below cohomology of oriented etale products
statement:
Let $I$ be a small cofiltered category in the size convention [def-weil-size-convention], and let $(X_i\to S_i\leftarrow Y_i)_{i\in I}$ be an inverse system of diagrams of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, with quasi-compact quasi-separated arrows [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Assume all three component transition morphisms are affine (inverse images of affine opens are affine). Let $X,S,Y$ be the componentwise inverse limits and put
$$P_i=(X_i)_{\mathrm{Et}}\overleftarrow\times_{(S_i)_{\mathrm{Et}}}(Y_i)_{\mathrm{Et}},\qquad P=X_{\mathrm{Et}}\overleftarrow\times_{S_{\mathrm{Et}}}Y_{\mathrm{Et}}$$
using the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and left oriented products [lem-trf-oriented-product-universal]. Write $u_{ji}:P_j\to P_i$ and $u_i:P\to P_i$ for the induced geometric morphisms. Fix $i_0\in I$, a commutative ring $\Lambda$, and $K\in D^+(P_{i_0},\Lambda)$, the bounded-below derived category of sheaves of constant-$\Lambda$ modules [def-trf-oriented-nearby-cycles, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every integer $n$, the canonical pullback maps give an isomorphism
$$\varinjlim_{(a:j\to i_0)\in(I/i_0)^{\mathrm{op}}} H^n(R\Gamma(P_j,u_{ji_0}^*K))\ \xrightarrow{\sim}\ H^n(R\Gamma(P,u_{i_0}^*K)).$$
Here $R\Gamma$ is total right derived global sections, computed by K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex], and the pullbacks are the exact constant-coefficient inverse images. The isomorphism is natural in $K$ and commutes with restriction along a morphism of such inverse systems and with the adjunction-unit maps defining cohomological pullback. No torsion, constructibility or finite-dimensional hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Exposé XI 1.10(b), localization (1.b)–(1.c), and 2.5–2.7, especially the inverse limits and their cohomology comparisons (2.c)–(2.e), printed pp. 175–176, 179–181. General affine-transition form of this continuity input; the finite-cover site cohomology theorem is Stacks sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 09YP (lemma-colimit), with sites.tex Tag 09YL (lemma-colimit-sites).
